questions.q: Which of these is a mental benefit of exercise?
questions.why: Reduced stress is mental; bones and blood pressure are physical; friends is social.

questions.q: A BMI of 31 puts a person in which category?
questions.why: BMI of 30 or more is obese.

questions.q: Which body type is wide-shouldered, narrow-hipped and muscular?
questions.why: Mesomorphs have a muscular, athletic build.

questions.q: Explain how a sedentary lifestyle can harm health.
questions.model: Little activity can cause weight gain and obesity, which raises the risk of coronary heart disease and type 2 diabetes. It also weakens bones and muscles and can lower mood and self-esteem.
